QF.id: I Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_47

question.text: Trades of custodial participants that are not confirmed by their clearing members within the prescribed facility/timeframe are:

answer.text: Treated as trades of the trading member who entered them (proprietary)
Settled at the next day's price

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 160-161 of the NISM Series I Currency Derivatives workbook (December 2025) state that trades of custodial participants not confirmed by the clearing members of those custodial participants are considered trades pertaining to the trading member who entered them, and form part of the obligations of that trading member's clearing member. The Trap: The confirming party is the clearing member of the custodial participant, not the custodial participant itself. The trades are not cancelled, re-priced to the next day, or shifted to the clearing corporation; they become the trading member's own (proprietary) obligation. Note: Wording aligned to pages 160-161 to correctly identify clearing members of CPs as the confirming party.
